cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The race taught us a lot about pacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's where we'll start the review. You choose the pace; I'll time us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set me a halfway target for next time. I'll carry the stopwatch.

reason: A accepts B halfway observation as a training location and gives B target control while avoiding the finish comparison.
